name: Nythran Ascendancy
government: Council where organic minds and AI intelligences hold equal votes. Ideological divisions: Cyber-Symbiotes (fully merged, pro-integration) vs Traditionalists (partially organic, resist total AI dependence).

notes: One of the seven major galactic civilizations; underwent controlled, gradual AI integration so organic minds and AI coexist as equal citizens. Timeline-attested: the Nythran Cyber Uprising (First Civilization Expansion era).

naming_exemption.reason: Civilization name "Nythran Ascendancy" preserved verbatim from the cited Major Civilizations codex and the canonical timeline.
source_refs: canon/L2/timeline/GUMAS_Galactic_Timeline_Detailed_Enhanced.json (First Civilization Expansion era: Velar-Harkon Wars, Nythran Cyber Uprising)

citizenry: Two peoples as equal citizens: Nythran organics AND AI intelligences (co-equal council votes). The polity is not reducible to the Nythran species alone.
peoplehood_note: A STATE, not a people. Its citizenry deliberately spans organic Nythrans and AI persons.
identity_model_note: Polity = a state / political entity, an orthogonal dimension from species (people), culture, and region. A polity does not describe a whole people.
